title: "Set Movement Route" causing control switches not to work...

posts.author: Bladeboy05
posts.body: I have a cut scene where guards flees and later on they are killed, so when they are killed, after the movement route plays through and then a control switch "Dead Guards" turns on for all four guards . The switch in this case switches all four guards to the next page in their separate map events, which is turn on by the switch "Dead Guards". All of them but one does not switch for some odd reason. I work thorugh a process of elimination and it turns out that the "Set Movement Route" I had for the "bugged" guard that doesn't want to switch was stopping the switch from turning on. No matter if I delete that guard as a map event and make a new event, or even delete the movement route or attach that guard to a different Control Switch I get the same results, the only time I can get the control switch to work with that specific guard and I mean that guard only is to not set a "Movement route" for it. It didn't matter where I placed that guard on the map and how many steps I added or took away the same results of failure unless I removed the "Set Movement route". Is this a known bug? Could this be the engine because the MZ engine is by fare the buggiest one I've tried, I heard that RPG Maker Unite is far worse... Any way, I would love to hear some feedback.

posts.author: Zia_
posts.body:
Maybe your routes can't be finished and cause your events to get stuck. Maybe some Switches are mixed up or your event pages are in a wrong order.
Without screenshots of your events, it's impossible to guess.
